title: Second-Order Linear with Constant Coefficients
welcome_lead: Solve oscillators and decays using the auxiliary equation method.
meta_desc: IBDP HL Maths adventure on second-order linear ODEs with constant coefficients.
final_note: Roots of the auxiliary equation classify the solution shape!

concepts.def: a y'' + b y' + c y = 0 constant coefficients.
a m^2 + b m + c = 0 with roots m_1, m_2.
y = A e^(m1 x) + B e^(m2 x).
y = (A + Bx) e^(mx) when m_1 = m_2 = m.
y = e^(αx)(A cos βx + B sin βx).
y(0) and y'(0) determine A and B.

options: e^(αx)(A cos βx + B sin βx)
A cos x + B sin x
